en: And it came to pass that when two hundred and ten years had passed away there were many churches in the land; yea, there were many churches which professed to know the Christ, and yet they did deny the more parts of his gospel, insomuch that they did receive all manner of wickedness, and did administer that which was sacred unto him to whom it had been forbidden because of unworthiness.

nv: dóó ákogo éiyá díí sodizin bá hooghan éí shinaʼnitin bee ábiiʼdiilyaago índa ataaʼ biyiʼjįʼ binaanish ííshjání íidoolííł.

en: And if it so be that the church is built upon my gospel then will the Father show forth his own works in it.

en: And thus ended also the eighty-seventh year of the reign of the judges, the greater part of the people remaining in their pride and wickedness, and a lesser part walking more circumspectly before God.
nv: dóó ákótʼáo ándahwiiʼaahii dadínéezbindóó tseebídiin dóó baʼaan tsostsʼid ałdóʼ ałtso nááhai, diné ałnííʼ bilááhdóó tʼahdii ádaa dahaʼniih dóó bąąhági átʼéii yaa naakai, dóó tʼáá áłchʼį́į́dígo hazhóʼó diyin god bibeehazʼáanii yikééʼ deíkááh.

en: And thus ended also the eighty-seventh year of the reign of the judges, the more part of the people remaining in their pride and wickedness, and the lesser part walking more circumspectly before God.
nv: dóó ákótʼáo ándahwiiʼaahii dadínéezbindóó tseebídiin dóó baʼaan tsostsʼid ałdóʼ ałtso nááhai, diné ałnííʼ bilááhdóó tʼahdii ádaa dahaʼniih dóó bąąhági átʼéii yaa naakai, dóó tʼáá áłchʼį́į́dígo hazhóʼó diyin god bibeehazʼáanii yikééʼ deíkááh.

en: And thus we see all of mankind were fallen, and they were within the grasp of justice; yes, the justice of God, which consigned them forever to be severed from his presence.
nv: dóó ákótʼáo diné tʼáá ałtso adaheezhtłizh dóó tʼáá ákogi átʼáo ánihwiitʼaah bílákʼejiʼaah silį́į́ʼ; áko diyin god tʼáá ákogi átʼáo bibee ánihwiitʼaahii, éí hoolʼáágóó bichʼįʼ hadáʼdidoolkał.

en: And thus we see that all mankind were fallen, and they were in the grasp of justice; yea, the justice of God, which consigned them forever to be cut off from his presence.
nv: dóó ákótʼáo diné tʼáá ałtso adaheezhtłizh dóó tʼáá ákogi átʼáo ánihwiitʼaah bílákʼejiʼaah silį́į́ʼ; áko diyin god tʼáá ákogi átʼáo bibee ánihwiitʼaahii, éí hoolʼáágóó bichʼįʼ hadáʼdidoolkał.

en: And thus were the Lamanites afflicted also, and began to decrease as to their faith and righteousness, because of the wickedness of the arising generation.

en: And thus were the Lamanites afflicted too, and began to decrease in their faith and righteousness, on account of the wickedness of the arising generation.

en: And thus the ninety-second year did pass away, bringing glad tidings unto the people because of the signs which did come to pass, according to the words of the prophecy of all the holy prophets.

en: And thus the ninety-second year passed, bringing great tidings to the people because of the signs which came to pass, according to the words of a prophecy of all the holy prophets.

en: And it is the faith which we have had on the things which our king has spoken unto us that has brought us to this great knowledge, whereby we do rejoice with such exceedingly great joy.

en: And it’s the faith that we’ve had on the things that our king has spoken to us that brought us to this great knowledge; whereby, we rejoice with such exceedingly great joy.
nv: dóó aláahdi nihinaatʼáanii yee haadzíʼígíí deiniidlą́ągo biniinaa díí ayóó átʼáo ééhózinii nihił béédahoozin, áko índa tʼáá íiyisíí nihił dahóózhǫǫd.

en: And when the crowd had eaten and were filled, he said to the disciples: Behold there shall one be ordained among you, and to him will I give power that he will break bread and bless it and give it to the people of my church, to all those who will believe and be baptized in my name.
nv: dóó áłah jílínę́ę daʼiiyą́ą́ʼ dóó yee hwiih daazlį́įʼgo, akééʼ naazíinii kwíídííniid: jó nihitahdóó tʼááłáʼí bee deesįįł, dóó éí bááh yikʼi sońdílzįįh dóó ałtsʼánéítih dooleeł dóó shisodizin bá hooghan ńdeidiiláhígíí, dashoosdląądígíí dóó shízhiʼ binahjįʼ tó bee dadoolzį́łígíí, yaa neikaah dooleeł.

en: And when the multitude had eaten and were filled, he said unto the disciples: Behold there shall one be ordained among you, and to him will I give power that he shall break bread and bless it and give it unto the people of my church, unto all those who shall believe and be baptized in my name.

en: And also that they might give thanks to the Lord their God, who had brought them out of the land of Jerusalem, and who had delivered them out of the hands of their enemies, and had appointed just men to be their teachers, and also a just man to be their king, who had established peace in the land of Zarahemla, and who had taught them to keep the commandments of God, that they might rejoice and be filled with love towards God and all men.

en: And also that they might thank the Lord their God, who’d brought them from the land of Jerusalem, and who’d delivered them from the hands of their enemies, and had appointed just men to be their teachers, and also a just man to be their king, who had established peace in the land of Zarahemla, and who taught them to keep the commandments of God, that they might rejoice and be filled with love towards God and all men.

en: Neither did they receive any to baptism, save they came forth broken-hearted and of contrite spirit, and witnessed to the church they truly repented of all their sins.
nv: dóó ałdóʼ tsʼídá bąąhági ádáátʼįįdę́ę yaa yínííł danízinígíí, dóó sodizin bá hooghan yee daʼatahígíí yínááł beʼiinaʼ łahgo ánádayiidlaago tó yee deisį́į́h.

en: Neither did they receive any unto baptism save they came forth with a broken heart and a contrite spirit, and witnessed unto the church that they truly repented of all their sins.
nv: dóó ałdóʼ tsʼídá bąąhági ádáátʼįįdę́ę yaa yínííł danízinígíí, dóó sodizin bá hooghan yee daʼatahígíí yínááł beʼiinaʼ łahgo ánádayiidlaago tó yee deisį́į́h.

en: And if there were miracles wrought then, why has God ceased to be a God of miracles and yet be an unchangeable Being?

en: And if there were miracles wrought then, why’s God ceased to be the God of miracles and yet be an unchangeable Being?

en: And he said unto Alma: What does this mean which Amulek hath spoken concerning the resurrection of the dead, that all shall rise from the dead, both the just and the unjust, and are brought to stand before God to be judged according to their works?

nv: dóó ałtso yichʼįʼ yáłtiʼgo, diné táltʼéhę́ę yichʼįʼ yiizįʼ, dóó kwíídííniid: nihíshąʼ éí ataaʼ bichʼįʼ anáásdzáá dóó bikʼijįʼ, haʼátʼíí bee nihíká adeeshwoł danohsin?

en: And about the time that Ammaron hid up the records unto the Lord, he came unto me, (I being about ten years of age, and I began to be learned somewhat after the manner of the learning of my people) and Ammaron said unto me: I perceive that thou art a sober child, and art quick to observe;

en: And around the time that Ammaron hid up the records to the Lord, he came to me, (I being about ten years of age, and I began to be learned somewhat after a manner of the learning of my people) and Ammaron told me: I perceive that you’re a sober child, and are quick to observe;

en: And it shall come to pass that all lying, and deceiving, and envying, and strife, and priestcraft, and whoredom, shall be done away.
nv: dóó baa dahodoolzhish tʼáá ńtʼę́ę́ʼ yoochʼííd, dóó naʼadloʼ, dóó oolchʼį́į́d, dóó daʼahijigą́, béeso yikʼé sodadilzinígíí, dóó aláahdi joodláhígíí, ałtso ndahidootʼiʼ.

en: And it shall come to pass that all lyings, and deceivings, and envyings, and strifes, and priestcrafts, and whoredoms, shall be done away.
nv: dóó baa dahodoolzhish tʼáá ńtʼę́ę́ʼ yoochʼííd, dóó naʼadloʼ, dóó oolchʼį́į́d, dóó daʼahijigą́, béeso yikʼé sodadilzinígíí, dóó aláahdi joodláhígíí, ałtso ndahidootʼiʼ.

en: And when I desire to rejoice, my heart groaneth because of my sins; nevertheless, I know in whom I have trusted.
nv: dóó baa shił hózhǫ́ǫ doo nisingo, shijéí neezgai łeh, shibąąhági átʼéii biniinaa; ákótʼée ndi, baʼííníshłíhígíí éí shił bééhózin.

en: And they were strict to observe that there should be no iniquity among them; and whoever was found to commit iniquity, and three witnesses of the church condemned them before the elders, and if they didn’t repent, and didn’t confess, their names were blotted out, and they were not numbered among the people of Christ.
nv: dóó bąąhági átʼéii bitah dooleełígíí ayóó yaa daastiʼ, dóó háiida bąąhági ádzaago hádeilʼį́ʼígíí, dóó éí elder danilínígíí binááł sodizin bá hooghan yee dah deíkáhígíí táltʼéego daʼooʼínígíí yá ndahwiiʼaah ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, dóó doo beʼiinaʼ łahgo ánéídlééhgóó, dóó doo ádaa halneʼgóó, éí bízhiʼ nahjįʼ kódeileʼ, dóó doo éí christ dayoodlánígíí daʼatah da.

en: And they were strict to observe that there should be no iniquity among them; and whoso was found to commit iniquity, and three witnesses of the church did condemn them before the elders, and if they repented not, and confessed not, their names were blotted out, and they were not numbered among the people of Christ.
nv: dóó bąąhági átʼéii bitah dooleełígíí ayóó yaa daastiʼ, dóó háiida bąąhági ádzaago hádeilʼį́ʼígíí, dóó éí elder danilínígíí binááł sodizin bá hooghan yee dah deíkáhígíí táltʼéego daʼooʼínígíí yá ndahwiiʼaah ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, dóó doo beʼiinaʼ łahgo ánéídlééhgóó, dóó doo ádaa halneʼgóó, éí bízhiʼ nahjįʼ kódeileʼ, dóó doo éí christ dayoodlánígíí daʼatah da.

en: He is not angry, vengeful, or retaliatory. His very purpose—His work and His glory—is to mentor us, exalt us, and lead us to His fulness.

en: He’s not angry, vengeful, or retaliatory. His very purpose—His work and His glory—is to mentor to us, exalt us, and lead us into His fullness.
nv: doo báháchį’ da, doo atí’éł’į́į da, doo k’éédíshdlé nizin da. yiniiyé át’ínígíí éí—bi naanish dóó yee ayóó’át’éii—yee nanhintin, dego ánhilééh dóó yee át’éii yaa nihidoolóós.

en: And there were no gifts from the Lord, and the Holy Ghost did not come upon any, because of their wickedness and unbelief.
nv: dóó bóhólníihii éí doo akʼihojídlíi da silį́į́ʼ, dóó iiʼsizį́ diyinii éí tʼáá háiida doo bił hólǫ́ǫ da ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, háálá bąąhági átʼéii yaa naakaiígíí dóó doo daʼoodlánígíí biniinaa.

en: And there were no gifts from the Lord, and the Holy Spirit didn’t come upon any, because of their wickedness and unbelief.

en: And Christ had said: If you will have faith in me you shall have power to do whatever thing is expedient in me.

en: And Christ hath said: If ye will have faith in me ye shall have power to do whatsoever thing is expedient in me.
nv: dóó christ ání: dashiinohdlą́ągo éí tʼáá ałtsoní nihá yáʼátʼééh nisinígíí ádadoohłííł.

en: And if ye shall believe in Christ ye will believe in these words, for they are the words of Christ, and he hath given them unto me; and they teach all men that they should do good.

en: And if you’ll believe in Christ you’ll believe in these words, for they’re the words of Christ, and he has given them to me; and they teach all men that they should do good.

en: And for this cause he fulfilleth the words which he hath given, and he lieth not, but fulfilleth all his words.

nv: dóó naalnish da; dóó bík’is nigháigoo yił náákai da; t’áá doole’é azhdóólíłígíí doońdi bízhneel’ą́ą da.

en: And again the Lord called others, and said unto them likewise; and he gave unto them power to baptize.
nv: dóó nááná bóhólníihii łaʼ wóshdę́ę́ʼ náánéidooʼniid, dóó kótʼéego yichʼįʼ hanáánáádzííʼ; dóó tó bee alzį́į́hjígo adziilii yaa yizlá.

en: And again, the Lord called the others, and told them likewise; and he gave them power to baptize.
nv: dóó nááná bóhólníihii łaʼ wóshdę́ę́ʼ náánéidooʼniid, dóó kótʼéego yichʼįʼ hanáánáádzííʼ; dóó tó bee alzį́į́hjígo adziilii yaa yizlá.

en: And again the third time they did hear the voice, and did open their ears to hear it; and their eyes were towards the sound thereof; and they did look steadfastly towards heaven, from whence the sound came.
nv: dóó nááná tááʼ góneʼ hanááʼoodzíiʼgo índa iinééʼ dazhdiiztsʼą́ą́ʼ, dóó deididootsʼį́į́ł biniiyé bijaaʼ ąą ádayiilaa; dóó hodiitsʼaʼígíí yichʼįʼ dadéeʼį́į́ʼ, dóó yáʼąąsh gódei, doo nahjįʼ kódaanééhgóó hodiiztsʼą́ą́ʼjígo dadéeʼį́į́ʼ.

en: And again the third time they heard the voice and opened their ears to hear it; and their eyes were toward the sound thereof; and they looked steadfastly towards heaven, from where the sound came.
nv: dóó nááná tááʼ góneʼ hanááʼoodzíiʼgo índa iinééʼ dazhdiiztsʼą́ą́ʼ, dóó deididootsʼį́į́ł biniiyé bijaaʼ ąą ádayiilaa; dóó hodiitsʼaʼígíí yichʼįʼ dadéeʼį́į́ʼ, dóó yáʼąąsh gódei, doo nahjįʼ kódaanééhgóó hodiiztsʼą́ą́ʼjígo dadéeʼį́į́ʼ.

en: And again, inasmuch as parents have children in Zion, or in any of her stakes which are organized, that teach them not to understand the doctrine of repentance, faith in Christ the Son of the living God, and of baptism and the gift of the Holy Ghost by the laying on of the hands, when eight years old, the sin be upon the heads of the parents.
nv: dóó naaná, azheʼé dóó amá ziongi baʼáłchíní holǫ́ǫgo, éí doodaó sodizin bahoghan naazniljí bił hoo dzohjí biyi éí diyin bisodizin báhooghan hashtʼéʼ ádalyaa, báʼáłchíni tseebíí bináághaigo díí dashijaaʼígíí, iinaʼ łahgo ánálnéeh dóó diyin god hiináago biyeʼ jesus christ woodlánigíí dóó toʼ bee ałzį́́į́h, dóó atsiitʼááh dahʼadéesniigo níłchʼi diyinii iiʼsizíinii aa yílyéii, doo yee neeneestą́ą́ʼgó éí bááhági átʼéii, amá dóó azheʼé tʼááʼ áłah bikʼijį siʼą́ą dooleeł.

en: And again, so much as parents have kids in Zion, or in any of her stakes that are organized, that teach them to not comprehend the doctrine of repentance, faith in Christ the Son of the living God, and of the baptism and the gift of the Holy Spirit by the laying of the hands, when eight years old, the sin will be upon the heads of the parents.
nv: dóó naaná, azheʼé dóó amá ziongi baʼáłchíní holǫ́ǫgo, éí doodaó sodizin bahoghan naazniljí bił hoo dzohjí biyi éí diyin bisodizin báhooghan hashtʼéʼ ádalyaa, báʼáłchíni tseebíí bináághaigo díí dashijaaʼígíí, iinaʼ łahgo ánálnéeh dóó diyin god hiináago biyeʼ jesus christ woodlánigíí dóó toʼ bee ałzį́́į́h, dóó atsiitʼááh dahʼadéesniigo níłchʼi diyinii iiʼsizíinii aa yílyéii, doo yee neeneestą́ą́ʼgó éí bááhági átʼéii, amá dóó azheʼé tʼááʼ áłah bikʼijį siʼą́ą dooleeł.

en: And again, there was another church that denied the Christ; and they persecuted the true church of Christ, because of their humility and their belief in Christ; and they despised them because of the many miracles that were wrought among them.
nv: dóó nááná, náánáłaʼ sodizin bá hooghan léiʼ christ doo deiniidlą́ą da daaní; áádóó tʼáá aaníí christ bisodizin bá hooghanę́ę dayoołchʼį́į́d, háálá éí diné hojoobaʼ ádeinízingo dóó christ dayoodlą́ągo biniinaa; dóó deijoosłááʼ háálá ląʼída éí bitahgóó álílee diyinkʼehgo naʼanish ádaalyaahą́ą biniinaa.

en: And again, there was another church which denied the Christ; and they did persecute the true church of Christ, because of their humility and their belief in Christ; and they did despise them because of the many miracles which were wrought among them.
nv: dóó nááná, náánáłaʼ sodizin bá hooghan léiʼ christ doo deiniidlą́ą da daaní; áádóó tʼáá aaníí christ bisodizin bá hooghanę́ę dayoołchʼį́į́d, háálá éí diné hojoobaʼ ádeinízingo dóó christ dayoodlą́ągo biniinaa; dóó deijoosłááʼ háálá ląʼída éí bitahgóó álílee diyinkʼehgo naʼanish ádaalyaahą́ą biniinaa.

en: And know that you will be judges of this people, according to the judgment which I shall give to you, which will be just.
nv: dóó nihí naakitsʼáadahí danohłíinii nihił hashneʼ, tʼáá ákótʼéego anáhidootʼáłígíí nihaa deeshłééł éí éí bikʼehgo, díí diné bá ndahwidiyootʼááł.

en: And know ye that ye shall be judges of this people, according to the judgment which I shall give unto you, which shall be just.
nv: dóó nihí naakitsʼáadahí danohłíinii nihił hashneʼ, tʼáá ákótʼéego anáhidootʼáłígíí nihaa deeshłééł éí éí bikʼehgo, díí diné bá ndahwidiyootʼááł.

en: And after I and my brethren and all the house of Ishmael had come down unto the tent of my father, they did give thanks unto the Lord their God; and they did offer sacrifice and burnt offerings unto him.
nv: dóó shí dóó shikʼisóó dóó ishmael dóó tʼáá átʼé bighan hazʼáanii shizhéʼé biníbaaljįʼ bił náníshkaigo índa, bóhólníihii bidiyin god ahéheeʼ dadííniid; dóó naaldlooshii kǫʼ yee yichʼįʼ náádaʼiisniiʼ.

en: And after my brethren and I and all the house of Ishmael had come down to my father’s tent, they gave thanks to the Lord their God; and they offered sacrifice and burnt offerings to him.
nv: dóó shí dóó shikʼisóó dóó ishmael dóó tʼáá átʼé bighan hazʼáanii shizhéʼé biníbaaljįʼ bił náníshkaigo índa, bóhólníihii bidiyin god ahéheeʼ dadííniid; dóó naaldlooshii kǫʼ yee yichʼįʼ náádaʼiisniiʼ.

en: And I, Nephi, began to fear exceedingly lest the Lord should be angry with us, and smite us because of our iniquity, that we should be swallowed up in the depths of the sea; wherefore, I, Nephi, began to speak to them with much soberness; but behold they were angry with me, saying: We will not that our younger brother shall be a ruler over us.
nv: dóó shí, nephi, tʼáá íiyisíí nísísdzííd tʼáá hazhóʼó bóhólníihii nihá hodoochįįł ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, dóó atínihóleʼ lágo niizį́į́ʼ háálá bąąhági átʼéii baa ńdiideeʼígíí biniinaa, tónteel biyiʼjįʼ kónihóleʼ lágo; ákohgo shí, nephi, tʼáá íiyisíí hazhóʼó bichʼįʼ yáʼniiłtiʼ; ndi shichʼįʼ dahaschįįd, kódaaníigo: nihí éí, nihitsilí doo nihinaatʼáanii nilį́į dooleeł da.

en: And I, Nephi, began to greatly fear pr the Lord should be angry with us, and smite us because of our iniquity, that we should be swallowed up in the depths of the sea; why, I, Nephi, began to speak to them with great soberness; but behold they were angry with me, saying: We won’t that our younger brother shall be a ruler over us.
nv: dóó shí, nephi, tʼáá íiyisíí nísísdzííd tʼáá hazhóʼó bóhólníihii nihá hodoochįįł ńtʼę́ę́ʼ, dóó atínihóleʼ lágo niizį́į́ʼ háálá bąąhági átʼéii baa ńdiideeʼígíí biniinaa, tónteel biyiʼjįʼ kónihóleʼ lágo; ákohgo shí, nephi, tʼáá íiyisíí hazhóʼó bichʼįʼ yáʼniiłtiʼ; ndi shichʼįʼ dahaschįįd, kódaaníigo: nihí éí, nihitsilí doo nihinaatʼáanii nilį́į dooleeł da.

en: And mine eyes have beheld great things, yea, even too great for man; therefore I was bidden that I should not write them.
nv: dóó shinááʼ bee tʼáadoo leʼé ayóó átʼéii nééłʼį́į́ʼ, aooʼ, diné yidoołtséłígíí éí doo yíneelʼáanii ndi; éí bąą éí doo bikááʼ ádíílíił da shiʼdooʼniid.

en: And my eyes have seen great things, yes, even too great for man; therefore I was bidden that I shouldn’t write them.
nv: dóó shinááʼ bee tʼáadoo leʼé ayóó átʼéii nééłʼį́į́ʼ, aooʼ, diné yidoołtséłígíí éí doo yíneelʼáanii ndi; éí bąą éí doo bikááʼ ádíílíił da shiʼdooʼniid.

en: And when my father saw that the waters of the river emptied into the fountain of the Red Sea, he spake unto Laman, saying: O that thou mightest be like unto this river, continually running into the fountain of all righteousness!
nv: dóó shizhéʼé tó nílínę́ę tónteel łichíiʼgo dah siyínígíí biih yílį́įgo yiyiiłtsą́ągo, kóníigo, laman yichʼįʼ haadzííʼ: o tó nílínígi áńtʼée dooleełę́ę, tʼáá áłahjįʼ yáʼátʼéehii bee nííséeł dooleeł.

en: And when my father saw that the waters of the river emptied into the fountain of the Red Sea, he spoke to Laman, saying: Oh that you might be like this river, continually running into the fountain of all righteousness!
nv: dóó shizhéʼé tó nílínę́ę tónteel łichíiʼgo dah siyínígíí biih yílį́įgo yiyiiłtsą́ągo, kóníigo, laman yichʼįʼ haadzííʼ: o tó nílínígi áńtʼée dooleełę́ę, tʼáá áłahjįʼ yáʼátʼéehii bee nííséeł dooleeł.

en: More than once, someone has said to me after my testimony, “How did you know what I so needed to hear?”
nv: dóo t’áałáhidi da, t’áa’aaníí bee haasdzígo bik’ijį’, “háiit’áosh ts’ída nísinígíí bee háinidzíí’?”

en: More than one time, someone said to me after my testimony, “How did you know what I needed to hear so much?”
nv: dóo t’áałáhidi da, t’áa’aaníí bee haasdzígo bik’ijį’, “háiit’áosh ts’ída nísinígíí bee háinidzíí’?”

en: And after they had been received in baptism, and were wrought upon and cleansed by the power of the Holy Ghost, they were numbered among the people of the church of Christ; and their names were taken, that they may be remembered and nourished by the good word of God, to keep them in the right way, to keep them continually watchful in prayer, relying alone upon the merits of Christ, who was the author and the finisher of their faith.
nv: dóó tó bee dabiʼdiilzį́įʼgo, dóó iiʼsizį́ diyinii bibee adziilii bindaashnish dóó doo bąąh chinígóó ábiilaago índa, christ bisodizin bá hooghan yee dayikahígíí yitah hakááh; áádóó bízhiʼ éí náhádlááh, áko diyin god bizaad yáʼátʼéehii bee bééhániih dóó bee baa áháyą́ą doo biniiyé, áko yáʼátʼééh hońtʼiʼjįʼ deíkáahgo óólzin doo, dóó sodizin tʼáá áłahjįʼ yee ádaa ádahalyą́ą doo, christ bibee ajoobaʼígíí tʼéiyá yadaʼólíigo, éí éiyá beʼoodląʼ bá áyiilaa dóó bá ałtso ííłʼį́.

en: And after they had been received unto baptism, and were wrought upon and cleansed by the power of the Holy Ghost, they were numbered among the people of the church of Christ; and their names were taken, that they might be remembered and nourished by the good word of God, to keep them in the right way, to keep them continually watchful unto prayer, relying alone upon the merits of Christ, who was the author and the finisher of their faith.
nv: dóó tó bee dabiʼdiilzį́įʼgo, dóó iiʼsizį́ diyinii bibee adziilii bindaashnish dóó doo bąąh chinígóó ábiilaago índa, christ bisodizin bá hooghan yee dayikahígíí yitah hakááh; áádóó bízhiʼ éí náhádlááh, áko diyin god bizaad yáʼátʼéehii bee bééhániih dóó bee baa áháyą́ą doo biniiyé, áko yáʼátʼééh hońtʼiʼjįʼ deíkáahgo óólzin doo, dóó sodizin tʼáá áłahjįʼ yee ádaa ádahalyą́ą doo, christ bibee ajoobaʼígíí tʼéiyá yadaʼólíigo, éí éiyá beʼoodląʼ bá áyiilaa dóó bá ałtso ííłʼį́.

en: And he came down by the borders near the shore of the Red Sea; and he traveled in the wilderness in the borders which are nearer the Red Sea; and he did travel in the wilderness with his family, which consisted of my mother, Sariah, and my elder brothers, who were Laman, Lemuel, and Sam.
nv: dóó tónteel łichííʼ yibąąhgóó níyá; dóó tónteel łichííʼ bibąąhgóó doo diné kééhatʼínígi níyá; dóó baʼáłchíní doo diné kééhatʼínígi yił níná, éí éí shimá, sariah, dóó shínaaí, laman, lemuel, dóó sam.

en: And he came down by the borders near the shore of the Red Sea; and he traveled in the wilderness within the borders which are nearer the Red Sea; and he traveled in the wilderness with his family, which consisted of my mother, Sariah, and my elder brothers, who were Laman, Lemuel, and Sam.
nv: dóó tónteel łichííʼ yibąąhgóó níyá; dóó tónteel łichííʼ bibąąhgóó doo diné kééhatʼínígi níyá; dóó baʼáłchíní doo diné kééhatʼínígi yił níná, éí éí shimá, sariah, dóó shínaaí, laman, lemuel, dóó sam.

en: And every one that heard these sayings of mine and didn’t do them shall be likened to a foolish man, who built his house on the sand—
nv: dóó tʼáá ałtso díí ádíshnínígíí yidiiztsʼą́ʼígíí dóó doo yeʼiilaaígíí éí diné doo áhályáanii, bighan séí yikááʼ hooghan niiníʼáanii nahalingo, baa ntséskees dooleeł—

en: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine and doeth them not shall be likened unto a foolish man, who built his house upon the sand—
nv: dóó tʼáá ałtso díí ádíshnínígíí yidiiztsʼą́ʼígíí dóó doo yeʼiilaaígíí éí diné doo áhályáanii, bighan séí yikááʼ hooghan niiníʼáanii nahalingo, baa ntséskees dooleeł—

en: And the words I have written in weakness will be strengthened for them; for it persuaded them to do good; it made their fathers known to them; and it spoke of Jesus, and persuaded them to believe in him, and to endure to the end, which is eternal life.
nv: dóó tʼáá ałtso saad doo dabidziilgóó nááházo yę́ę éí, dabidziilgo bichʼįʼ ádadoolnííł; binahjįʼ naanish yáʼátʼéehii ádeidoolííł; dóó ałkʼidą́ą́ʼ dabizhéʼé yę́ę bił ííshją́ą́ ádadoolnííł; dóó jesus yaa yáłtiʼ, dóó éí deidoodląął, dóó nihookááʼ iiná bijį́įjįʼ daʼoodlą́ągo, éí hoolʼáágóó iiná shódeidoołtʼeełgo yaa halneʼ.

en: And the words which I have written in weakness will be made strong unto them; for it persuadeth them to do good; it maketh known unto them of their fathers; and it speaketh of Jesus, and persuadeth them to believe in him, and to endure to the end, which is life eternal.
nv: dóó tʼáá ałtso saad doo dabidziilgóó nááházo yę́ę éí, dabidziilgo bichʼįʼ ádadoolnííł; binahjįʼ naanish yáʼátʼéehii ádeidoolííł; dóó ałkʼidą́ą́ʼ dabizhéʼé yę́ę bił ííshją́ą́ ádadoolnííł; dóó jesus yaa yáłtiʼ, dóó éí deidoodląął, dóó nihookááʼ iiná bijį́įjįʼ daʼoodlą́ągo, éí hoolʼáágóó iiná shódeidoołtʼeełgo yaa halneʼ.

en: And there was no light seen, neither fire, nor glimmer, neither the sun nor the moon, nor the stars, for so great were the mists of darkness that were upon the face of the land.
nv: dóó tʼáá háadi da adinídíín dooleełígíí éí ádin, doo kǫʼ ndi, doodago tʼįįhdígo dałichíʼígíí ndi, doo ndi jóhonaaʼéí, doodago ooljééʼ da, doodago sǫʼ ndi, doo daatʼį́į ndi da, háálá tʼáá ałtso kéyah bikááʼgóó chahałheeł ditą́ągo niʼ nikéshgishígíí biniinaa.

en: And there was not any light seen, neither fire, nor glimmer, neither the sun, nor the moon, nor the stars, for so great were the mists of darkness which were upon the face of the land.
nv: dóó tʼáá háadi da adinídíín dooleełígíí éí ádin, doo kǫʼ ndi, doodago tʼįįhdígo dałichíʼígíí ndi, doo ndi jóhonaaʼéí, doodago ooljééʼ da, doodago sǫʼ ndi, doo daatʼį́į ndi da, háálá tʼáá ałtso kéyah bikááʼgóó chahałheeł ditą́ągo niʼ nikéshgishígíí biniinaa.

en: And there was nothing aside from the power of God, which threatened them all with destruction, could soften their hearts; why, when they saw that they were about to be swallowed up in the depths of the sea they repented of the thing they’d done, so much that they released me.
nv: dóó tʼáá hazhóʼó diyin god bibee adziilii, nabidoołtsiłgo bił ííshją́ą́ ályaago índa, hazhóʼó ntsíńdoohkos; ákohgo, kʼadę́ę tónteel abiłnéehgo índa ádáádzaa yę́ę yąąh bíniʼ dóó beʼiinaʼ łahgo áńdayiidlaa, wónáásdóó shéédadeezhchid.

en: And there was nothing save it were the power of God, which threatened them with destruction, could soften their hearts; wherefore, when they saw that they were about to be swallowed up in the depths of the sea they repented of the thing which they had done, insomuch that they loosed me.
nv: dóó tʼáá hazhóʼó diyin god bibee adziilii, nabidoołtsiłgo bił ííshją́ą́ ályaago índa, hazhóʼó ntsíńdoohkos; ákohgo, kʼadę́ę tónteel abiłnéehgo índa ádáádzaa yę́ę yąąh bíniʼ dóó beʼiinaʼ łahgo áńdayiidlaa, wónáásdóó shéédadeezhchid.

en: And they began from that moment forth to call upon his name; therefore God spoke with men and made the plan of redemption known to them, which had been prepared from the foundation of the world; and he made this known to them according to their faith and repentance and their holy works.
nv: dóó wónáásdóó yichʼįʼ sodadilzingo yaa ńdiikai; éí bąą diyin god diné yił halneʼ silį́į́ʼ, dóó nináʼílyáago nahatʼáhígíí yił ííshją́ą́ áyiilaa, éí nahasdzáán álnééhdą́ą́ʼ hashtʼeelyaa; dóó díí éí bedaʼoodląʼ dóó beʼiinaʼ łahgo áńdayiidlaa dóó binaanish diyingo yindaashnishígíí bikʼehgo yił ííshją́ą́ áyiilaa.

en: And they began from that time forth to call on his name; therefore God conversed with men, and made known unto them the plan of redemption, which had been prepared from the foundation of the world; and this he made known unto them according to their faith and repentance and their holy works.
nv: dóó wónáásdóó yichʼįʼ sodadilzingo yaa ńdiikai; éí bąą diyin god diné yił halneʼ silį́į́ʼ, dóó nináʼílyáago nahatʼáhígíí yił ííshją́ą́ áyiilaa, éí nahasdzáán álnééhdą́ą́ʼ hashtʼeelyaa; dóó díí éí bedaʼoodląʼ dóó beʼiinaʼ łahgo áńdayiidlaa dóó binaanish diyingo yindaashnishígíí bikʼehgo yił ííshją́ą́ áyiilaa.

en: And he said unto them: On this wise shall ye baptize; and there shall be no disputations among you.
nv: dóó yichʼįʼ haadzííʼ: kótʼéego tó bee daʼohłsį́įh doo; dóó tʼáadoo bee ałghadaʼdohtʼáhí dooleeł.

en: And he told them: On this wise you shall baptize; and there shall be no disputes among you.
nv: dóó yichʼįʼ haadzííʼ: kótʼéego tó bee daʼohłsį́įh doo; dóó tʼáadoo bee ałghadaʼdohtʼáhí dooleeł.

en: And we did sojourn for the space of many years, yea, even eight years in the wilderness.

en: And we journeyed for several years, yes, even eight years in the wilderness.
